commit.message:
deploy: the credential script lives inside the working tree

Round three of verification sized the sandbox exactly: staging agents wrote
their Render API script in the checkout and passed; main agents wrote it to
/tmp, where the sandbox gates execution no matter what the allowlist says,
declined to probe around the gate, and produced no record — failing loudly,
as designed. The charter now pins the location: inside the working tree,
outside pipeline/releases/ so the record commit stays clean.
